Fixes clicking on notes.

- A quick click now selects the note even if your hand moves a little. A press only becomes a drag when the pointer travels about 10 px, or is held for a moment and then moves.
- Pressing a note no longer puts the whole layout into drag mode, so a plain click no longer jolts the graph or springs the note out from under the cursor.
- A click belongs to the note you pressed, even if it drifted slightly before you let go.
- Double-click opens the note even when the camera has moved away after the first click; Ctrl or Cmd plus click opens it in a new tab.
